cues: In time t, a charge I t moves through a potential difference V.
The work done on it is V I t, and all of it becomes heat.
Using V equals I R, the heat is I squared R t, or V squared t over R.
And the rate of heating, the power, is I squared R, or V squared over R.
text: In time t, a charge I t moves through a potential difference V. The work done on it is V I t, and all of it becomes heat. Using V equals I R, the heat is I squared R t, or V squared t over R. And the rate of heating, the power, is I squared R, or V squared over R. This is Joule's law.
